en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a small European town nestled in a valley surrounded by forested hills and mountains. The focal point is a prominent church with a tall clock tower and spire in the center of the town. The buildings feature traditional sloped roofs. The image has an old-fashioned, vintage appearance, with visible aging on the card. Text at the bottom reads 'Hermagor im Gailtale, Kärnten.'
